content_data.meeting_title: Checkout Service Performance Optimization Sprint Planning
agenda_items: Evaluate migration strategy from monolithic checkout to microservices architecture
Review API rate limiting issues affecting third-party payment integrations
Plan load testing scenarios for upcoming peak shopping season
key_decisions: Agreed to defer full microservices migration until after peak season, focusing on critical path optimization
Established 200ms p95 latency target for checkout API endpoints
technical_blockers: Legacy payment gateway SDK lacks async support, causing thread blocking in checkout flow
Insufficient staging environment capacity to accurately simulate production traffic patterns

conversation.speaker: user_agent

conversation.speaker: user_agent

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Great, I can help you add new meeting notes.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: What was the title or purpose of the meeting?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: The meeting was for Checkout Service Performance Optimization Sprint Planning.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: The agenda items included evaluating the migration strategy from monolithic checkout to microservices, reviewing API rate limiting issues affecting third-party payment integrations, and planning load testing scenarios for the upcoming peak shopping season.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: We agreed to defer the full microservices migration until after peak season, focusing on critical path optimization, and established a 200ms p95 latency target for checkout API endpoints.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: The technical blockers include the legacy payment gateway SDK lacking async support, causing thread blocking, and insufficient staging environment capacity to simulate production traffic patterns accurately.
